source_snapshot.title: Dubai Basketball stun Real Madrid in 78-77 thriller
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: Dubai Basketball made a stunning start to their EuroLeague campaign on Thursday night, edging Spanish powerhouse Real Madrid 78-77 in front of a packed Coca-Cola Arena..In a fiercely contested game with neither side able to pull clear, Dubai Basketball kept their composure when it mattered most to clinch a narrow one-point win and begin their second EuroLeague campaign in memorable fashion..Prior to the start of the game, both teams, coaching staff and the packed crowd held a minute’s silence to pay tribute to the late His Highness Sheikh Ahmed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, who passed away on Monday. Dubai is observing a 10-day official mourning period, with flags across the city being flown at half-mast..When the action got under way the two sides traded blows from the opening tip, with Dubai Basketball finishing the first quarter 20-16 ahead. Real Madrid hit back in the second, outscoring the hosts 28-18 to establish a 44-38 lead at the interval..Dubai responded impressively after the restart, producing a 25-18 third quarter to move back in front. The final 10 minutes were just as tight, with both teams scoring 15 points, but Dubai remained composed when the pressure was at its highest to hold on for a historic one-point triumph..Dwayne Bacon topped Dubai’s scoring with 24 points, while Mfiondu Kabengele and Filip Petrušev played key roles defensively as the hosts stayed disciplined until the final buzzer..After the final buzzer, Dubai Basketball head coach Xavi Pascual commended his players for their display and also acknowledged the passionate supporters who packed out the Coca-Cola Arena for the opening game..“I was completely focused on the game, which, as I said, was a very special one. First of all, I would like to thank all the fans who came here,” said Pascual..“I hope that day by day we can gain more and more fans. That will be the best win we can achieve this season – to make people love basketball in Dubai and feel that they are part of this project.”.Pascual added: “I am sure that the people who came here enjoyed themselves a lot, so I am very happy for them. My sincere thanks to everyone for being here with us.”.Dubai Basketball will now turn its attention to its next EuroLeague home fixture, with FC Barcelona visiting Coca-Cola Arena on Tuesday, 29 September..Tickets on sale for Dubai Basketball’s home openers.Real Madrid win Euroleague basketball SuperCup in Abu Dhabi

title: Dubai Basketball stun Real Madrid in 78-77 thriller
summary_ru: Dubai Basketball обыграл Real Madrid со счётом 78-77 В четверг вечером Dubai Basketball начал свой второй сезон в Евролиге с победы над испанским Real Madrid — 78-77 при переполненной Coca-Cola Arena. Игра прошла в упорной борьбе, и хозяева сохранили хладнокровие в решающий момент. Перед началом матча обе команды, тренерские штабы и зрители почтили минутой молчания память шейха Ахмеда бин Рашида Аль Мактума, скончавшегося в понедельник. В Дубае объявлен 10-дневный официальный траур, флаги в городе приспущены. По ходу встречи Dubai Basketball вёл 20-16 после первой четверти, но Real Madrid вышел вперёд 44-38 к перерыву. В третьей четверти хозяева отыгрались (25-18), а в последней обе команды набрали по 15 очков. Двейн Бэкон набрал 24 очка, Мфионду Кабенгеле и Филип Петрушев сыграли ключевую роль в защите.
